target.statement: LaSagnA achieves 42.0 mIoU on ADE20K closed-set semantic segmentation (Table 1).

compute.basis: Training LaSagnA requires 8 A100 GPUs for ~50 hours (paper states), which is infeasible on a CPU-only laptop; even with a GPU, the 7B vLLM and SAM ViT-H backbone demand substantial VRAM and time.

blockers: Large model (LLaVA-7B + SAM ViT-H) needs high VRAM
title: LaSagnA: Language-based Segmentation Assistant for Complex Queries
